content:
I would like to ask whether we should replace push_neg with push Not. Currently push_neg is a macro for push Not.

The advantage of using push Not is that it teaches people about the push tactic. The advantage of a separate push_neg tactic is that it can have its own docstring.

/poll push_neg vs push Not
Continue using push_neg
Prefer using push Not
Based on the poll, push Not is the winner. I've now created #36392 to deprecate push_neg in favour of push Not.
